facts.text: Caroline joined a new LGBTQ activist group called 'Connected LGBTQ Activists' on Tuesday, which includes people who are passionate about rights and community support.

evidence.quote: I just joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues. I'm meeting so many cool people who are as passionate as I am about rights and community support.
Our group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists', is made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes.

facts.text: Caroline and Melanie discussed recent events, with Caroline mentioning that the city held a pride parade last weekend, which included people marching with flags and signs to celebrate love and diversity.

evidence.quote: Last weekend our city held a pride parade! So many people marched through the streets waving flags, holding signs and celebrating love and diversity.
Have you been part of any events or campaigns lately?

facts.text: Melanie mentioned that she and her children went to the beach recently, and the children had a lot of fun playing with a kite.

evidence.quote: Oh yeah, we went to the beach recently. It was awesome! The kids had such a blast.
Seeing my kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best! We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year.
